name: @thoryn/examples-e2e
description: Shared Playwright harness for the example recipes' browser E2E. Each recipe owns its spec under recipes/<id>/e2e/ (colocated with the recipe it validates); this root package holds the single node_modules so those colocated specs resolve @playwright/test, plus the reusable harness under e2e/ (staging/Mailpit config + email capture in e2e/lib, the one Playwright config with a project per recipe, and the per-recipe E2E_RESULTS.md reporter). SCAFFOLD — activates once the CI secrets exist and a first live run passes.
